title: Chicken Kabsa
author: farag4m

step.title: Season chicken
step.text: Season the chicken generously with salt, black pepper, allspice, Kabsa spices, and a little paprika.

step.title: Saute onion and garlic
step.text: Using Saute mode, cook the diced onion in a little oil until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for another 30–60 seconds.

step.title: Make Kabsa sauce
step.text: Add tomato paste and saute for 1–2 minutes. Add tomato sauce, Kabsa spices, allspice, black pepper, paprika, and salt. Saute until fragrant and well combined.

step.title: Add rice
step.text: Mix the reserved chicken broth with the Kabsa sauce, adding water as needed to make about 3 cups total liquid. Add 3 cups rinsed rice and stir once.

step.title: Pressure cook chicken
step.text: Place the seasoned chicken in the pressure cooker and add enough water to approximately reach the surface of the chicken. Pressure cook on High for 15 minutes. Remove the chicken and reserve all of the broth.

step.title: Saute chicken in Kabsa sauce
step.text: Return the chicken to the prepared Kabsa sauce. Saute until the chicken is well coated and picks up some color, then remove the chicken and set aside.

step.title: Prepare rice
step.text: Add the reserved chicken broth to the Kabsa sauce remaining in the pot. Add water as needed to make about 3 cups total liquid, then add the rinsed rice and stir once.

step.title: Add chicken
step.text: Place the Kabsa-coated chicken on top of the rice.

step.title: Final cook
step.text: Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes. Fluff the rice and serve with the chicken on top.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only recipe. The onion, garlic, tomato paste, tomato sauce, and spices form the Kabsa sauce. The reserved chicken broth is mixed with this sauce and used to cook the rice so the rice absorbs the chicken and Kabsa flavors.
